name: Enterprise Tenant and SSO Architecture
description: Design the enterprise tenant model, SSO federation (SAML/OIDC), and SCIM provisioning architecture. Define tenant isolation boundaries, identity provider abstraction layer, federation trust model, user/group provisioning via SCIM, and the mapping between IdP identities and local principals. Produce architecture document with identity flow diagrams covering login, IdP-initiated SSO, just-in-time provisioning, and deprovisioning.
purpose: Enterprise customers require multi-tenant isolation with single sign-on through their corporate identity provider and automated user provisioning/deprovisioning via SCIM. A clean tenant model and SSO architecture is the foundation for all enterprise governance features.
acceptanceCriteria: Architecture document defines tenant model with isolation boundaries, multi-tenant data separation, and tenant lifecycle
Identity flow diagrams cover SP-initiated SSO, IdP-initiated SSO, JIT provisioning, group sync, and deprovisioning
SCIM provisioning schema defined with attribute mapping between IdP and local principal model
